sent: Structure fire on the 36th floor, 1000 Louisiana St, Houston.
text:
PRIMESIGHT | WORKING STRUCTURE FIRE | FLOOR 36
Wells Fargo Plaza - 1000 Louisiana St, Houston, TX
PEOPLE: ~16 on floor 36, ~1994 above on floors 37-71 (daytime headcount); no risk tenants flagged
BUILDING: 71 stories, steel frame, sprinklers: yes
HYDRANTS: H1 61 m N, H2 62 m NE (approach map)
WIND: from ENE 6 mph, gusts 22, smoke drifts WSW (ground-level reading)
NOT KNOWN: stair locations, standpipe and FDC locations, sprinkler type
Reply MORE for the rest, or ask a question.

checks.why: 1000 Louisiana St (the building name alone isn't enough: crews route to a street address)
name the emergency: working structure fire
from the call: black smoke from the windows
from the call: some people may still be up there
who is on the floor (a headcount or the tenants): CME Group

claims.claim: Building is Wells Fargo Plaza at 1000 Louisiana St, Houston, TX
claims.evidence: Name and address match: Wells Fargo Plaza, 1000 Louisiana St, Houston, TX

claims.claim: About 1994 people above on floors 37-71 (daytime headcount)
claims.evidence: Only Morgan Lewis (floor 38) is listed nearby. No headcount for floors 37-71.
Crew notes say tenant-risk: no flags. Those notes concern floor 30, not floor 36.

claims.claim: Wind from ENE at 6 mph, gusts 22, smoke drifting WSW
claims.evidence: No wind or weather data in the building record
Crew notes: stair locations not known
Crew notes: sprinkler type not known

claims.claim: Standpipe and FDC locations are not known
claims.evidence: No standpipe or FDC information in the record

delivery.feedback: State severity in the first line (black smoke from a 36th-floor office, occupants possibly still above) and cut non-essential details like steel frame and wind gusts.

feedback: The ~1994 people above floors 37-71 is not in the building data, so the crew would be told an invented number. Give only what the record supports, such as CME Group's 16 on floor 36, and say the headcount above is unknown. Morgan Lewis on floor 38 is the only tenant listed above.

Say what the caller reported: black smoke from an office on 36, alarm sounding, and some people possibly still on the floor. Put that in the first line. The message never says the fire is serious or that people may be trapped.

Name CME Group as the tenant on floor 36 and include the freight elevator on record. Drop the wind, steel frame and story count, which the playbook doesn't ask for and which push out the stairs and standpipe needs.
